item.title: Reflections on how to feel more passionate and interested again in your craft
item.author: w3dg@duck.com (Debopam Gupta)
item.description:
Recently, I watched this video that came across my feed “WHY NOTHING FEELS INTERESTING ANYMORE (and how to fix it with neuroscience) ” by Olga Loiek.

She explains that the main reason something gets us excited is because the activity causes dopamine in our brain to spike. That is also the reason why we might feel the opposite way at present.
